instructions.title: Withdraw your petition: before you file (do not file this page)
lines: This file has the Petitioner's Verified Request for Dismissal (PO-0108) with your answers printed on it.
If you are worried about your safety, an advocate can talk with you about it before you file. Their help is free.
Sign and date it by hand. You sign under penalty of perjury.
Print 3 copies, unless the clerk tells you otherwise: one for the court, one for the other person, and one for you.
File it with the clerk of the court that has your case.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.
